description: Analyze the structure of one or more dashboards.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Analyze the structure of the dashboard titled 'Sales Overview'.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the structure of the 'Sales Overview' dashboard, identifying widget counts and jump-to-dashboard instances.

examples.user_query: Check the structure of dashboards with IDs 'dashboard_123' and 'dashboard_456'.
examples.notes: This call processes two dashboards by their IDs, providing insights into their structure and complexity.

examples.user_query: Analyze the complexity of the dashboard named 'Marketing Performance'.
examples.notes: This call evaluates the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard, counting widgets and identifying child dashboards linked via jump-to-dashboard functionality.

description: Compute widget counts for one or more dashboards.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: How many widgets are on the 'Sales Overview' dashboard?
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Sales Overview' dashboard by its title and returns the widget count.

examples.user_query: Can you check the widget counts for dashboards with IDs '12345' and '67890'?
examples.notes: This call retrieves widget counts for two dashboards using their Sisense IDs.

examples.user_query: I need a summary of widget counts for the 'Marketing Performance' dashboard and the dashboard with ID '54321'.
examples.notes: This call processes one dashboard by title and another by ID, providing a summary of widget counts for both.

description: Analyze pivot widgets on one or more dashboards and report those with many fields.

dashboards.description: One or more dashboard references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a Sisense dashboard ID, or - a dashboard title (name). At least one dashboard reference is required. At runtime this method is tolerant of a single string being passed instead of a list, and will normalize it to a one-element list.

max_fields.description: Threshold for the number of fields on a pivot widget. Only pivot widgets with more than this number of fields are included in the returned data. Defaults to 20.

examples.user_query: Find pivot widgets with too many fields on the 'Sales Overview' dashboard.
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Sales Overview' dashboard and identifies pivot widgets with more than 25 fields.

examples.user_query: Check all pivot widgets on dashboards 'Finance Dashboard' and 'HR Analytics' for excessive fields.
examples.notes: This call scans the 'Finance Dashboard' and 'HR Analytics' dashboards for pivot widgets with more than 20 fields, which is the default threshold.

examples.user_query: Analyze pivot widgets on dashboard ID '5f3a8b2c9d1e4a0012345678' and report those with over 30 fields.
examples.notes: This call targets a specific dashboard by its ID and identifies pivot widgets with more than 30 fields.
